# Ayodeji Eluwande

> AI product manager and builder in Berlin, originally from Lagos. Connects product discovery, agent workflows, technical implementation and operational delivery.

Key facts:

- Lead AI Product Manager - Operations at Skilladder AI, since May 2025. The assessment platform has served 32 enterprise clients in total, including six recurring clients (confirmed by Ayodeji, September 2026).
- Previously Product Manager at Tellerpoint (May 2024 - April 2026), Devlabs Africa and Switch Recycling.
- Work spans assessment systems, WhatsApp commerce, agent orchestration, client platforms and independent experiments. Product leadership contributions are distinguished from hands-on builds.
- AI development tools include Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and Gemini.
- Education: Bachelor of Laws, Lagos State University.

## Selected work

- [Skilladder](https://ayodejieluwande.vercel.app/work/skilladder): Assessment design, rubric-based grading, review and delivery. Includes a labelled synthetic walkthrough.
- [Orderflow](https://ayodejieluwande.vercel.app/work/orderflow): Shared commerce infrastructure across business workflows. Includes an illustrative payment-state diagram; no live payment is made.
- [Onboarding Engine](https://ayodejieluwande.vercel.app/work/onboarding-engine): Explorer, Synthesizer and Writer stages, with inspectable synthetic artifacts. Direct Slack, Notion and GitHub connectors remain planned.
- [Football Ladder](https://footballadder.com/): AWS-hosted early-access website for a football career simulation.
- [Hotel California](https://github.com/IamDejman/hotel-california): Browser-agent prototype source. The portfolio does not present a completed recorded run or a leaderboard score.
